{
  "milestones": [
    {
      "id": "m1",
      "title": "Add __getitem__ to VersionInfo",
      "requests": [
        "R1"
      ],
      "requirement": "Implement __getitem__ on VersionInfo so that version_info[index] returns the corresponding part (0=major, 1=minor, 2=patch, 3=prerelease, 4=build).",
      "observable": "v = VersionInfo.parse('1.2.3-rc.1+b'); v[0] == 1; v[1] == 2; v[2] == 3; v[3] == 'rc.1'; v[4] == 'b'; v[5] raises IndexError.",
      "public_names": [
        "VersionInfo.__getitem__"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": "This is a standalone feature addition to the class interface."
    },
    {
      "id": "m2",
      "title": "Allow list and str in comparator types",
      "requests": [
        "R2"
      ],
      "requirement": "Extend the comparator wrapper's allowed types to include list and str so that comparisons like v < [1,2,4] and v < '1.2.4' work without TypeError.",
      "observable": "v = VersionInfo.parse('1.2.3'); v < [1,2,4] is True; v < '1.2.4' is True; v < {'major':1,'minor':2,'patch':4} is True; v < 'invalid-string' raises TypeError or ValueError as appropriate for invalid semver, but NOT TypeError about type not being in allowed list.",
      "public_names": [
        "comparator"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": "The comparator function is a standalone helper used by all dunder comparison methods; updating its internal comparable_types tuple is a prerequisite for any comparison behavior change."
    },
    {
      "id": "m3",
      "title": "Refactor VersionInfo bump methods to be self-contained",
      "requests": [
        "R3"
      ],
      "requirement": "Move implementation logic from module-level functions into VersionInfo methods (e.g., bump_major) so they do not depend on calling module-level helpers, preparing for deprecation of those helpers.",
      "observable": "v = VersionInfo.parse('1.0.0'); new_v = v.bump_major(); assert isinstance(new_v, VersionInfo); assert new_v.major == 2; assert new_v.minor == 0; assert new_v.patch == 0; assert new_v.prerelease is None; assert new_v.build is None.",
      "public_names": [
        "VersionInfo.bump_major",
        "VersionInfo.bump_minor",
        "VersionInfo.bump_patch",
        "VersionInfo.bump_prerelease",
        "VersionInfo.bump_build"
      ],
      "requires": [
        "m1"
      ],
      "why_requires": "To make VersionInfo methods self-contained, we need to ensure the class can manage its own state changes. m1 provides the standardized access pattern (__getitem__) which ensures consistent interpretation of version parts if validation or iteration logic is used within the new implementations. More critically, this milestone establishes the internal logic within the class methods themselves, removing the dependency on `semver.bump_*` calls inside `VersionInfo.bump_*`. The dependency on m1 is structural: ensuring the 'self-contained' nature implies using the instance's own data which is now reliably accessible via the public API defined in m1, allowing for cleaner internal implementation patterns that don't rely on external parsing/casting loops."
    },
    {
      "id": "m4",
      "title": "Deprecate module-level bump/finalize/format/parse functions",
      "requests": [
        "R3",
        "R6"
      ],
      "requirement": "Output a DeprecationWarning when calling semver.bump_major, bump_minor, bump_patch, bump_prerelease, bump_build, finalize_version, format_version, parse, and replace at the module level.",
      "observable": "import warnings; with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w: warnings.simplefilter('always'); semver.bump_major('1.0.0'); assert len(w) == 1; assert issubclass(w[0].category, DeprecationWarning); assert 'deprecated' in str(w[0].message).lower().",
      "public_names": [
        "bump_major",
        "bump_minor",
        "bump_patch",
        "bump_prerelease",
        "bump_build",
        "finalize_version",
        "format_version",
        "parse",
        "replace"
      ],
      "requires": [
        "m3"
      ],
      "why_requires": "R3 states that moving implementation into VersionInfo allows deprecating module-level functions without triggering false positives when calling methods. Therefore, m3 (making methods self-contained) must precede m4 (deprecating the module functions)."
    }
  ],
  "expected_causes": [
    "For m1: Developer might implement indexing starting from 1 instead of 0, or fail to handle prerelease/build parts correctly if they are None.",
    "For m2: Developer might forget to update the error message string to reflect the new types, causing test failures on exact string matching.",
    "For m3: Developer might leave residual calls to module-level functions inside VersionInfo methods, failing the self-containment requirement.",
    "For m4: Developer might apply the warning decorator incorrectly, causing the warning to point to internal code rather than the caller's line, or miss one of the listed functions."
  ],
  "verifier_plan": "m1: Instantiate VersionInfo with known parts, access indices 0-4, verify values, access index 5, verify IndexError. m2: Create VersionInfo instance, compare against list, string, dict, verify boolean results, compare against invalid type to ensure appropriate error. m3: Instantiate VersionInfo, call bump methods, verify return types and values match expected bumped versions, ensuring no external module functions are called during execution (can be verified by mocking module functions and asserting they aren't called). m4: Call each deprecated module function, capture warnings, verify exactly one DeprecationWarning is raised per call with expected message content."
}
